IMX708.//: Project tuning for the IMX708 (Arducam B0310, M12 120 deg lens, fixed focus) on an ESP32-P4 < rev 3.0. Derived from mushbraindave/esp_cam_sensor_imx 0.4.0 cfg/imx708_default.json (kept as imx708_default.upstream-0.4.0.json). It is used together with main/isp_ipa_hook.c (CONFIG_EXAMPLE_IMX708_COLOUR_PIPELINE), which applies the white balance in the LSC stage and removes the 64/1023 black pedestal: every luma and white-balance number below is in pedestal-free raw units (8-bit), not the pedestal-included values the upstream file was written for. 'writable' lets the firmware set the anti-flicker frequency from Kconfig (EXAMPLE_IMX708_ANTI_FLICKER_*) before the pipeline starts; ac_freq here is only the default. See docs/camera-formats.md, 'IMX708 image quality'.

agc.//: luma values are the AE block luminance after the pedestal is removed (linear, 0..255). target 46 = 18% grey through the sRGB curve below. Upstream had a 50..150 hold band, i.e. AE did nothing anywhere between 'dark' and 'blown' and the brightness depended on where it happened to stop; the band is now +-10%. Upstream also used low_light_priority, which weights the darker blocks up and blows the highlights of a bright scene; high_light_priority gives bright blocks (light fittings, white walls) extra weight instead, and only a few blocks brighter than 235 are ignored as light sources.

gamma.//: BT.709 transfer curve (upstream: x^0.72, which also clipped everything above 240). BT.709 rather than sRGB because its toe is 4.5x instead of 12.9x: this ISP works on 8-bit linear data, and a steeper toe turns each linear LSB of noise or black-level error into ~13 output levels of coloured shadow noise. The x points are log-spaced (the ISP only needs power-of-two steps) so the toe is sampled finely; the hook composes the black-level removal into it per channel. gamma_param is unused (use_gamma_param false) but the generator requires it.

awb.//: Grey world over 'white patch' candidates. The window is in pedestal-free raw R/G and B/G (the hook maps it into the post-LSC domain the ISP measures in). Upstream's window (rg 0.50..0.89, bg 0.48..0.78, pedestal included) excluded the real neutrals under the lab's LED lighting (white card: raw R/G 0.50, B/G 0.34), so AWB balanced on whatever else fell inside and left a yellow-green cast; and its 0.5 minimum gain step froze the first estimate for good. The window below covers the IMX708's daylight..tungsten locus with margin, still rejects saturated yellows/oranges (B/G ~0.1) and greens, and the gains track in 0.02 steps.

acc.//: CCM: upstream's uncalibrated seed with the green row pulling a further 0.15 x (R - G) out of green (rows still sum to 1, so neutrals are untouched). With the WB/black-level fixes in place that brought the orange reference box from 35-38 deg hue to ~32 deg while the yellow cable stays at 51-53 deg. A proper matrix needs a colour chart (24-patch) under the target light - see docs/camera-formats.md.
